expect.about: “Independent Directors” is used but not defined

cases.why: Real finding: D12-B defines “Independent Directors” but D12-C, the meeting variant for the same situation, does not. The Atlas facts are used with D12-C forced.

cases.title: D1-SP as drafted: “Offering Memorandum” and “Sponsor” used but not defined

expect.about: “Offering Memorandum” is used but not defined

cases.why: Real finding, and it may go away: U3 (the Subscription Terms) is incorporated and may define both, but U3 isn't drafted yet. Recheck when it is.

cases.title: Terms defined in the Offering Memorandum
cases.why: D13 uses “Company” and “Sponsor” without defining them and says words defined in the Offering Memorandum have the same meaning. The fixture lists the Offering Memorandum's terms in umbrella.json. “This Supplement” refers to the document itself.

cases.title: Proper names are not defined terms
cases.why: “Financial Services Commission”, “Securities and Investment Business Act” and “BVI Business Companies Act” are names, not defined terms.

cases.title: Singular use of a plural definition
Lower-case use is not a use of the term

changes.text: The issuer sells optical sensors to industrial customers.

cases.why: “issuer” in lower case is ordinary English and is neither a use of “Issuer” nor an undefined term.
